variant_desc: xxh3-style 12-multiply avalanche on 8-byte keys (~30 insns) -> CRC32 + single multiply (~5 insns x86) or 2-multiply Mulxsh (~3 insns ARM) (variant 4: seed=46, n_scale=0.7x)
source_citation: Birler, Schmidt, Fent, Neumann. CedarDB DaMoN'24 hash-table paper Figure 8.
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that for fixed-width 8-byte keys, an xxh3-style avalanche mixer is wasteful: a single CRC32 hardware instruction (x86-64 SSE4.2) provides adequate hash quality for in-memory hash tables. Compilers never perform cross-algorithm hash-function substitution because they cannot know whether the avalanche quality matters to the application. Portability: x86 path uses __builtin_ia32_crc32di; ARM/non-SSE4.2 falls back to a 2-multiply mix (still simpler than xxh3 though smaller speedup).
